page.layout: One printed page, one column of index entries, each entry a line. Running head at the top, page number at the top left, catchword "Pomo" at the lower right. The strip at the far right is the edge of the neighbouring page and is left out.

Petitionis verbo, ut significentur actiones in rem, l. pecuniæ 108. §. actionis, 2. de verb. sig.

plus cui licet, & minus licere videtur ca. cui licet, 53. eod.

Plus ut in se minus contineat, ca. plus 33. eo. ad ectio Plurisve ut non infinitam, sed modicam, ac interdum minutulam contineat pecuniam, l. hæc adjectio 162. de verb sig. in eo quod Plus est, ut insit minus, l. in eo 110. de reg. jur.

page.notes: Doubtful: the page number "1070" at the head, read as printed, may be 1670 or 1070. The running head "DECR." is printed with a space before the R. Long s in "speciosas" and "signi" is read as s. Numbers and citations are copied as printed. The entries are a single index column with no marginal notes. Some Latin abbreviations (e.g. "l.", "ca.", "eo.") are kept as printed. The right-hand strip belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
